method: Equal-sized independent seed batches; shared seeds and events across rule options within batch. Split tied wins. Confidence intervals use critical value 2.0009953781 across 60 batch means (exact t critical value for planned 30/60/100-batch reports, conservative cutoff otherwise); 5th/95th percentile and min/max describe single-300-game-batch variation. Paired rule/seat changes computed within each batch. No human-balance inference.
